pages.text: $(thing)Fusion Crafting/$ is a crafting recipe type that uses the $(item)Fusion Package Crafter/$ to craft recipes craftable in a $(item)Fusion Crafting Core/$.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: To use the $(item)Fusion Package Crafter/$, place enough sufficiently tiered $(item)Marked Injectors/$ at least 3 blocks away, facing the crafter unobstructed and connected to power.$(p)The $(item)Fusion Package Crafter/$ itself also requires some power.

pages.title: Usage (cont.)
pages.text: You can $(thing)$(k:sneak) + $(k:use)/$ with an empty hand on an idle $(item)Fusion Package Crafting Altar/$ to check its currently usable and required amount and tier of $(item)Marked Injectors/$.$(p)Items crafted by the $(item)Fusion Package Crafter/$ will be ejected into adjacent inventories.

pages.title: AE2 Integration
pages.text: The $(item)Fusion Package Crafter/$ and $(item)Marked Injectors/$ can be connected to an $(thing)ME Network/$.$(p)The crafter will extract power to use, and both the crafter and the injectors will instead eject crafted and remaining items into the network.
